user_decision: 2026-11-19: user finds the net-displacement definition weak, asked for the 'commanded motion not realized' history definition; approved a preregistered offline check.
question: Does a stall defined from the history of commanded motion that is not realized (i) get a stable threshold from the frozen data procedure, (ii) keep the mode-test quality of the 3 mm rule, (iii) keep the corrector off/on contrast, (iv) flag wrong modes no later than the 3 mm rule?
seen_before_freezing: dev logs only (unify0 NORULE c76700 seed 21): sent commands are world-frame (cos 0.98 with realized steps), free-motion realization gain about 0.43. No candidate was evaluated on the mode test before freezing. Known: old rule on Q400B TPR 1.0 FPR 0.300 AUROC 0.871; the 11-17 ratio (d24 / |sum c|, log Otsu 0.0547) was -7 pp closed loop, 1 seed.

definitions.per_step: c_t = 0.01 * action_exec[t, :3] (sent command incl. residual, m, world frame); r_t = ee_pos[t] - ee_pos[t-1]; progress along the command pi_t = r_t . c_t / |c_t| (0 if |c_t| < 1e-9)
definitions.window: trailing 24 steps s-23..s, s >= 24 (unchanged window; M unchanged)
definitions.RHO: realization ratio rho = sum pi / sum |c| ; stall = rho < threshold
definitions.U: accumulated unrealized command U = sum (|c| - pi), in mm ; stall = U > threshold
definitions.threshold: scale_rule_20261117 rule() (Otsu; linear vs log picked by eta; its internal floor 1e-4) on all pre-success steps of the dev logs. No other constants.

references.R1: 11-17 ratio: |ee_pos[s]-ee_pos[s-24]| / |sum c| < 0.0547 (fixed, reported for timing only)

data.holdout: qdata_20261116 arms Q200_OLD Q400_OLD Q200_NV Q400_NV QFULL_NV seed 20260921 (threshold stability only)
data.mode_test: same episodes and episode-level definition as resoff3_20261119 / stallc_20261119: window = steps 24..min(first success, first 90 deg rotation); score = earliness of the first flagged step; positive = flip (wrong mode). Arms Q400B (corrector on; evq_20261117 s21, b2_20261117 s22-23) and Q400B0 (off; resoff_cur_20261117 s21, resoff3_20261119 s22-23).

predictions_per_candidate.T1: holdout threshold within +-30% of dev and same scale pick
predictions_per_candidate.T2: corrector on: AUROC >= AUROC_OLD - 0.02, FPR <= FPR_OLD + 0.03, TPR >= TPR_OLD - 0.05
predictions_per_candidate.T4: flip episodes flagged by both: median (first_new - first_OLD) <= +12 steps and 90th percentile <= +36 steps

verdict.PASS(candidate): T1-T4 all true -> candidate for a closed-loop 3-seed check (needs user approval, new prereg)
verdict.NOT_ADOPTED(candidate): otherwise; recorded as is, no rerun of this gate without changes and user approval

expectation: uncertain; about 40% that at least one candidate passes. Main risk: the threshold procedure again lands on the free-motion split (too loose, FPR up) or too strict (late, T4 fails).
also_reported_exploratory: row-level agreement with OLD on Q400B
share of OLD stall flags with commanded path < 3 mm in the window (stopped on purpose)
FPR-matched comparison: threshold of each candidate set so that FPR_on equals FPR_OLD, then TPR and median delay (post hoc, not a verdict)
